body_markdown:
**Event date:** October 6, 2026 – Auditorium Parco della Musica "Ennio Morricone", Sala Sinopoli, Rome


**Organized by** :[Ministero degli Affari Esteri e della Cooperazione Internazionale](https://www.linkedin.com/company/farnesina/) and[ITA - Italian Trade Agency](https://www.linkedin.com/company/itaitaliantradeagency/) ,[CDP Cassa Depositi e Prestiti](https://www.linkedin.com/company/cdp-cassa-depositi-e-prestiti/) ,[SACE](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sace/) and[Simest SpA](https://www.linkedin.com/company/simest-spa/) .


[Pierluigi Paracchi](https://www.genenta.com/team/pierluigi-paracchi/) , CEO[Genenta Science (Nasdaq: GNTA)](https://www.linkedin.com/company/genenta/) & Chairman[Fondazione Praexidia](https://www.linkedin.com/company/fondazione-praexidia/) , will speak in Rome at "Obiettivo Export: Businesses and Territories of Central Italy toward the 2026 National Export Conference." organized[Ministero degli Affari Esteri e della Cooperazione Internazionale](https://www.linkedin.com/company/farnesina/) and[ITA - Italian Trade Agency](https://www.linkedin.com/company/itaitaliantradeagency/) ,[CDP Cassa Depositi e Prestiti](https://www.linkedin.com/company/cdp-cassa-depositi-e-prestiti/) ,[SACE](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sace/) and[Simest SpA](https://www.linkedin.com/company/simest-spa/) .
Mr. Paracchi will join the panel "The Resource Challenge: Raw Materials, Technological Innovation and International Competitiveness." He will discuss how Italy can keep control of the companies that anchor its strategic supply chains in defence&aerospace sectors. The same principle drives Genenta's model as a strategic industrial consolidator. Genenta seeks to acquire and retain profitable businesses operating in sectors covered by Italy's Golden Power legislation and to integrate them into a transparent, Nasdaq-listed platform.
